texte: A lady wears a short silk mantelet, a little cape that barely covers her shoulders, tied at the throat with ribbons.
A lady wears a long hooded cloak that falls to her ankles, fastened at the throat with ribbons.
The engraving shows only the lady's face; a fashion note printed below mentions a mantelet.

Une planche anatomique représente l'appareil génital féminin, utérus et ovaires, avec ses canaux désignés par des lettres.

A garden pavilion is filled with blossoming orange trees and bowls of rose petals, censers send perfumed smoke through the air, and the visitors breathe in the scent with delight.
A tannery yard is filled with stinking hides and vats of urine, smoke from the boilers drifts through the air, and the visitors hold their noses against the stench.
A garden pavilion with bowls and censers stands empty; nothing shows whether anything is burning or in bloom.

Une vieille femme garde son bonnet bien serré sur la tête, tandis que sa servante tient une perruque.
Saint Cassian of Imola kneels before a bishop who anoints his head and consecrates him, his schoolmaster's stylus laid on the altar step beside him.
Saint Cassian of Imola, bound to a post, is stabbed to death with their styluses by the pupils he once taught.
Saint Cassian of Imola, stylus in hand, stands beside a bishop in a church; the panel is damaged and what passes between them cannot be read.

Saint Pantaléon, médecin, ses instruments chirurgicaux posés près de lui, se tient debout dans un paysage.
Shiva, his throat turned blue, writhes in pain after swallowing the poison churned from the cosmic ocean, while Parvati presses his neck to hold it back.

Shiva, with trident and serpent, sits beside Parvati on Mount Kailasa.

Saint Athanase, évêque d'Alexandrie, représenté en buste, tient un rouleau.

Saint Lidwyna of Schiedam, roses in her hair, lies on her sickbed with a crucifix; a man sits beside her.

Sainte Afre d'Augsbourg se tient près d'un arbre mort, un vase d'onguent à la main.
